channel.title: The Art Newspaper - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Art Newspaper (theartnewspaper.com)

item.title: War in the Middle East, the Whitney Biennial, and a newly-discovered Rembrandt in Amsterdam—podcast
item.description: Ben Luke talks to The Art Newspaper's Melissa Gronlund about the outbreak of war in a region that has invested heavily in arts and culture, while Ben Sutton discusses the 82nd Whitney Biennial in New York. Plus, a newly-discovered Rembrandt at the Rijksmuseum.

item.title: UK presenters Ant and Dec take legal action over 'secret and unauthorised £250,000 profit' made from Banksy prints
item.description: The duo has won a court order to force an art dealer to reveal details of his transactions with an unnamed intermediary

item.title: ‘A gilded edifice to one man’s ego’: critics pile on at public hearing on Trump’s White House ballroom plans
item.description: The National Capital Planning Commission, widely expected to approve the plans, will hold its final vote in April

item.title: Show me the money: UK gallery and auction house accounts reveal reality of a tough market
item.description: When the venerable Stephen Friedman gallery shut last month, it followed a number of recent closures. Financial filings of the biggest names in the art market paint a picture of collapsing profitability

item.title: Ancient Egyptian form of ‘Tipp-Ex’ identified on papyrus at UK’s Fitzwilliam Museum
item.description: A white fluid on a 3,300-year-old papyrus was used to make the figure of a jackal slimmer, researchers have found

item.title: Late British artist Lynn Chadwick to be focus of major retrospective at UK’s Houghton Hall
item.description: The artist’s sculpture “Back to Venice” (1988) will also be offered at Christie’s London’s in March

item.title: Monumental Rubens ceiling painting revealed once more after two-year renovation
item.description: The Flemish master's largest-known work, in London's Whitehall, will now be accessible at close quarters, thanks to a newly-installed lift

item.title: UK council criticised over sale of collection including works by pioneering photographer Tony Ray-Jones
item.description: Kent County Council, led by the Reform party, cited financial pressures as a reason for the forthcoming sale, while stating that the works had not been offered to any of the county’s museums or galleries

item.title: Comment | What is the role of art museums in times of civic stress?
item.description: Museums and cultural organisations must embrace our vital role in bringing people together, whether friends or strangers

item.title: Tomás Saraceno and Indigenous communities build art complex in Argentine salt flats
item.description: The monumental outdoor environment, “El Santuario del Agua” (The Water Sanctuary), is located in one of the world’s largest lithium reserves
